title: "Ask AI"
description: "Send a prompt to an AI model using your own API key."
---

The **Ask AI** block is in the **API & Third Party** category in the Meridian builder.

Send a prompt to an AI model using your own API key..

## Settings

### API key

Your provider key or a Storage variable name.

### Model

Pick from the list or use a variable for a dynamic model id.

### System prompt

Instructions that shape how the model responds.

### Prompt

The user message sent to the model.

### Max tokens

Limit response length (1 to 8192).

### Save response to variable

Temporary variable for the reply and model id.
